oidc.title: No request-size bound anywhere in the Worker: anonymous bodies are fully buffered in isolate memory before any cap runs
oidc.root_cause: Request-body size is bounded only by the platform's upstream request limit, which is not visible or declared in the repository; the Worker buffers each body in full at least once (twice on the OAuth machine endpoints via clone + parseBody) before the earliest handler-level field cap is evaluated.

oidc.title: Uploaded conformance-results artifact may contain live client secrets, the seeded user password, and tokens
oidc.root_cause: The entire suite export directory is persisted as a workflow artifact without a scrub step, so any credentials or tokens present in the exported test logs become durable, downloadable artifacts.

oidc.title: Conformance workflow clones a third-party suite by mutable tag and executes it with CONFORMANCE_TOKEN and FLAREID_CONFORMANCE_API_KEY in the job environment
oidc.root_cause: The suite is fetched by mutable git tag rather than an immutable commit SHA, and secrets are declared at job level instead of step level, so tag-moved third-party code executes with both secrets in its environment.

oidc.title: Unpinned 'pip install httpx pyparsing' resolves newest PyPI release each run inside the secret-bearing job
oidc.root_cause: The pip install in a secret-bearing job is neither version-pinned nor integrity-bound, so registry-resolved code executes with repository secrets in its environment; the secrets are additionally scoped job-wide rather than step-wide.
